nomen.name: Cartesian Product
nomen.info: Create the cartesian product of two sets.

outputs.name: Product
outputs.info: Cartesian product of A⨯B, as a list of tuples.

nomen.name: Create Set
nomen.info: Create a valid set out of a list of values. Valid sets contain only unique elements.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: Source list containing all elements for the set.

outputs.name: Set
outputs.info: Set containing only the unique elements in the input list.

outputs.name: Filter
outputs.info: Retention filter applied to the input list.

nomen.name: Cull Consecutive
nomen.info: Delete consecutive identical values from a list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List with repeated values to cull.

inputs.name: Cyclical
inputs.info: Treat the list as a cyclical collection.

nomen.name: Disjoint Set
nomen.info: Test whether two sets are fully disjoint.

outputs.name: Disjoint
outputs.info: Disjoint state. If true, A and B share no values.

nomen.name: Find Similar
nomen.info: Find the value in a list which is most similar to a given value.

inputs.name: Values
inputs.info: List of values to search in.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value most similar to the given search criterion.

outputs.name: Index
outputs.info: Index of the most similar value.

nomen.name: Key Value Search
nomen.info: Find a matching key in a list and output the value associated with it.

inputs.name: Keys
inputs.info: List of keys to search in.

inputs.name: Values
inputs.info: List of associated values, one for each key.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value associated with the found key.

outputs.name: Index
outputs.info: Index of the found key, or -1 if no key matched the search.

nomen.name: Set Exclusion
nomen.info: Create the exclusion (or symmetric difference) of two sets. That is, a new set containing all the values which occur either in A or in B, but not both.

outputs.name: Exclusion
outputs.info: Set containing the elements present in either A, or B, but not both.

nomen.name: Set Intersection
nomen.info: Create the new set containing only the elements which occur in all inputs.

outputs.name: Intersection
outputs.info: Set containing the elements shared amongst all inputs.

nomen.name: Set Majority
nomen.info: Find all values which appear in at least two out of three sets.

outputs.name: Majority
outputs.info: Set containing all values which appear in at least two of the inputs.

nomen.name: Set Subtraction
nomen.info: Create a set which contais only those elements from set A that do not also occur in set B. Note that duplicate elements in A will be retrained.

outputs.name: Remainder
outputs.info: Set containing the elements present in A, but not in B.

nomen.name: Subset
nomen.info: Test whether one set is a proper subset of another.

outputs.name: Subset
outputs.info: Subset state. If true, all the values in B also appear in A.

nomen.name: Create Tuple
nomen.info: Combine several named values into a single tuple.

nomen.name: Dissolve Tuple
nomen.info: Dissolve a tuple into individual values.

nomen.name: Grow Tuple
nomen.info: Add or overwrite a single element to a tuple of named values.

nomen.name: Pare Tuple
nomen.info: Remove from a tuple all elements whose names match the given pattern.

nomen.name: Peek Tuple
nomen.info: Find a single element in a tuple of named values using the element's name.

inputs.name: Element Name
inputs.info: Name of element to search for.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.info: Value of found element, or null if no element is found.

nomen.name: Tuple From List
nomen.info: Create a tuple out of all the items in a list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List to convert into a tuple.

inputs.name: Element Name
inputs.info: Name for all elements. The index will be appended as a suffix to ensure uniqueness.

nomen.name: Tuple From Pear
nomen.info: Create a tuple out of a value and its associated meta data.

inputs.name: Meta Data
inputs.info: Optional meta data to use in case the value input lacks meta data.

outputs.name: Tuple
outputs.info: Tuple containing the input value and the meta data.

nomen.name: Tuple To List
nomen.info: Create a list out of all the elements in a tuple.

inputs.name: Tuple
inputs.info: Tuple to convert to a list.

outputs.name: Items
outputs.info: List of items matching the tuple elements.

nomen.name: Tuple To Pear
nomen.info: Extract the value and meta data from a correctly formatted tuple.

inputs.name: Tuple
inputs.info: A tuple containing a value and a meta data element.

nomen.name: Combine
nomen.info: Replace the null values in the first list with the parallel values of following lists. This component functions as the inverse of the Sift component. The Sift and Combine components are the preferred tools for conditional logic in Grasshopper.

nomen.name: Cull By Frequency
nomen.info: Remove every Nth item from a list.

inputs.name: Frequency
inputs.info: Culling frequency. From a given starting point, every Nth item will be culled.

inputs.name: Start
inputs.info: Index of first item to cull. If no start is given, culling begins at the last item of the first cycle, so every Nth item is culled.

nomen.name: Cull By Index
nomen.info: Remove all specified items from a list.

inputs.name: Indices
inputs.info: Indices of the items to be culled.

nomen.name: Cull By Pattern
nomen.info: Remove all indicated items from a list.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Culling pattern. Items paired up with the value `false` in the pattern are retained, while those paired up with the value `true` are culled.

nomen.name: Cull By Probability
nomen.info: Remove items from a list probabilistically.

inputs.name: Probability
inputs.info: Probability function between zero (definitely keep) and one (definitely cull). The function is evaluated at the list's indices to yield per-item probabilities.

nomen.name: Cull By Sites
nomen.info: Remove a specific set of items from a tree.

inputs.name: Sites
inputs.info: Sites of tree items to be removed.

outputs.name: Culled Tree
outputs.info: Tree with the specified items removed.

nomen.name: Cull By Value
nomen.info: Remove all items which are equal to one or more filter values.

inputs.name: Filter Values
inputs.info: Values to remove from the list.

nomen.name: Cull Nulls
nomen.info: Remove all null values from a list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List whose null values to remove.

nomen.name: Dispatch
nomen.info: Dispatch values to one of two outputs based on a boolean pattern.

outputs.name: True
outputs.info: Destination output for all items matched up with a `true` pattern value.

outputs.name: False
outputs.info: Destination output for all items matched up with a `false` pattern value.

nomen.name: Item From Site
nomen.info: Find an item in a tree, based on its site.

outputs.name: Item
outputs.info: The item at the given site.

outputs.name: Null
outputs.info: Null state at the given site.

nomen.name: Item From Index
nomen.info: Find an item in a list, based on its index.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of the item to be retrieved.

outputs.name: Item
outputs.info: The item at the given index.

outputs.name: Null
outputs.info: Null state at the given index.

nomen.name: Item From Index
nomen.info: Find an item in a list, based on its index.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of the item to be retrieved.

outputs.name: Item
outputs.info: The item at the given index.

nomen.name: Merge
nomen.info: Merge the values from several inputs into a single output.

nomen.name: Meta From Index
nomen.info: Find meta data in a list, based on its index.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List of value and meta pairs.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of item whose meta data to retrieve.

outputs.name: Metadata
outputs.info: The meta data of the item at the given index.

outputs.name: Null
outputs.info: Null state of the meta data at the given index.

nomen.name: Meta From Site
nomen.info: Find meta data in a tree, based on its site.

inputs.name: Tree
inputs.info: Tree of value and meta pairs.

inputs.name: Site
inputs.info: Site of meta data to retrieve.

outputs.name: Metadata
outputs.info: The meta data of the item at the given site.

outputs.name: Null
outputs.info: Null state of the meta data at the given site.

nomen.name: Random Reduce
nomen.info: Randomly remove a set number of elements from a list.

inputs.name: Remove
inputs.info: Optional number of items to remove. If unspecified, the `Retain` input must be set.

inputs.name: Retain
inputs.info: Optional number of items to retain. If unspecified, the `Remove` input must be set.

nomen.name: Random Select
nomen.info: Randomly select a number of elements from a list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List of items to select from.

nomen.name: Sift
nomen.info: Sift a list of items using an output index pattern. This component functions as the inverse of the Combine component. The Sift and Combine components are the preferred tools for conditional logic in Grasshopper.

nomen.name: List From Index
nomen.info: Find a list, or 'twig', based on its index within a tree.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of the list to be retrieved.

outputs.name: List
outputs.info: The list at the given index.

nomen.name: List From Path
nomen.info: Find a list, or 'twig', based on its path within a tree.

inputs.name: Path
inputs.info: Path of the list to be retrieved.

outputs.name: List
outputs.info: The list at the given path.

nomen.name: Churn
nomen.info: Randomly and cyclically shuffle the order of items in a list.

inputs.name: Vigour
inputs.info: Churning vigour. Zero means no shuffling at all, one equals total randomisation.

inputs.name: Random engine to use for churning.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

nomen.name: Combine Maps
nomen.info: Combine two or more index maps into a single map.

nomen.name: Crossing Pairs
nomen.info: Create pairs out of the elements of a given list.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List whose elements to pair up.

inputs.name: Omit Nulls
inputs.info: If true, omit any pairs containing null elements.

outputs.name: Primary Items
outputs.info: List containing the primary elements of all pairs.

outputs.name: Secondary Items
outputs.info: List containing the secondary elements of all pairs.

nomen.name: Cross Reference
nomen.info: Cross reference values in multiple lists with each other.

outputs.name: Groups
outputs.info: Groups consisting of all cross-references value combinations.

nomen.name: Cycle
nomen.info: Cycle the items in a list by shifting them forwards or backwards.

inputs.name: Offset
inputs.info: Number of steps in the cycling process. Negative offsets move items backwards.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

nomen.name: Identity Map
nomen.info: Create an identity index mapping for a list of a given length.

inputs.name: Length
inputs.info: Length of map. Negative lengths yield an index map which reverses the order of a list.

nomen.name: Invert Map
nomen.info: Invert an index map. An inverted map undoes the changes indicated by the original map.

nomen.name: Map Items
nomen.info: Reorder the items in a list as indicated by an index map.

nomen.name: Move To End
nomen.info: Move indicated items to the end of a list.

inputs.name: Indices
inputs.info: Indices of the items to be moved to the end of the list.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

nomen.name: Move To Start
nomen.info: Move indicated items to the start of a list.

inputs.name: Indices
inputs.info: Indices of the items to be moved to the start of the list.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

nomen.name: Offset Pairs
nomen.info: Pair up items in a given list based on an index offset.

inputs.name: List
inputs.info: List whose items to pair up.

inputs.name: First Offset
inputs.info: Offset of primary items. Positive offsets remove the leading items, while negative offsets remove the trailing items.

inputs.name: Second Offset
inputs.info: Offset of secondary items. Positive offsets remove the leading items, while negative offsets remove the trailing items.

outputs.name: Primary Items
outputs.info: List containing the primary elements of all pairs.

outputs.name: Secondary Items
outputs.info: List containing the secondary elements of all pairs.

nomen.name: Reverse
nomen.info: Reverse the items in a list by inverting their order.

nomen.name: Shake
nomen.info: Randomly shuffle the order of items in a list.

inputs.name: Vigour
inputs.info: Shaking vigour. Zero means no shuffling at all, one equals total randomisation.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

nomen.name: Sort
nomen.info: Sort the values in a list based on their intrinsic sorting order.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

nomen.name: Sort By Number
nomen.info: Reorder values based on a given numeric sorting order.

nomen.name: Sort By Text
nomen.info: Reorder values based on a given textual sorting order.

nomen.name: Sorting Key
nomen.info: Extract the sorting key of a given value. When collections contain differing or unknown types, items are sorted according to these keys, rather than type specific comparisons.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.info: Value whose sorting key to extract.

outputs.name: Key Fragments
outputs.info: Alternating textual and numeric fragments of the key.

nomen.name: Swap Items
nomen.info: Swap the places of items in a list, pair by pair.

inputs.name: Index A
inputs.info: First index of each swapping pair.

inputs.name: Index B
inputs.info: Second index of each swapping pair.

outputs.name: Index Map
outputs.info: Index map containing the changes applied to the list.

nomen.name: Bracket List
nomen.info: Insert a value at the start or the end of a list, or both.

inputs.name: Prepend
inputs.info: Optional value to add to the start of the list.

inputs.name: Append
inputs.info: Optional value to add to the end of the list.

nomen.name: Expand
nomen.info: Lengthen a list by repeating its items according to a specified repetition method.

nomen.name: Fragment List
nomen.info: Break a list of items into consecutive fragments at specified indices.

nomen.name: Insert Into List
nomen.info: Insert values into a list at indexed locations.

inputs.name: Items
inputs.info: Values to insert. If not specified, nulls will be inserted.

inputs.name: Indices
inputs.info: Insertion indices for each item. The indices refer to positions in the original list.

nomen.name: List Length
nomen.info: Count the number of items contained in a list, including all null values.

outputs.name: Length
outputs.info: Total number of values and nulls in the list.

nomen.name: List Statistics
nomen.info: Measure various statistics of the items contained in a list.

outputs.name: Length
outputs.info: Total number of items in the list.

outputs.name: Values
outputs.info: Number of actual, non-null values in the list.

outputs.name: Nulls
outputs.info: Number of nulls in the list.

outputs.name: Metas
outputs.info: Number of values with associated meta data.

nomen.name: Longest List
nomen.info: Expand lists in a collection until they are all equally long.

nomen.name: Partition List
nomen.info: Divide a list into consecutive shorter lists, using a specified pattern.

outputs.name: Segments
outputs.info: Consecutive parts of the original list.

nomen.name: Permutations
nomen.info: Create various permutations of a list.

inputs.name: Limit
inputs.info: Maximum number of permutations to generate.

inputs.name: Random
inputs.info: Optional random engine to use for permutation ordering.

outputs.name: Permutations
outputs.info: Tree containing permutations of the input list.

nomen.name: Pick And Mix
nomen.info: Build a list by picking items one at a time from two or more input lists.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Picking pattern. Each integer in this pattern specifies from which input list the next item is picked. The output will contain as many items as there are elements in the pattern.

nomen.name: Pick And Omit
nomen.info: Build a list by picking from competing items in two or more input lists.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Picking pattern. Each integer in this pattern specifies from which input list the next item is picked. The output will contain as many items as there are elements in the pattern.

nomen.name: Punch List
nomen.info: Exclude a contiguous set of items from a list.

inputs.name: First Index
inputs.info: Index of first value to be excluded.

inputs.name: Second Index
inputs.info: Index of last value to be excluded.

outputs.name: Punched List
outputs.info: List containing only the items before and after the excluded range.

nomen.name: Relative Item
nomen.info: Select pairs of items from the same tree using an offset pattern.

inputs.name: Offset Pattern
inputs.info: Offset pattern for path elements and item indices.

inputs.name: Wrap Paths
inputs.info: Wrap offset path elements when they exceed path limits.

inputs.name: Wrap Items
inputs.info: Wrap offset item indices when they exceed list limits.

inputs.name: Skip Singletons
inputs.info: Skip pairs with only a single defined element.

nomen.name: Relative Items
nomen.info: Select pairs of items from different trees using an offset pattern.

inputs.name: Offset Pattern
inputs.info: Offset pattern for path elements and item indices.

inputs.name: Wrap Paths
inputs.info: Wrap offset path elements when they exceed path limits.

inputs.name: Wrap Items
inputs.info: Wrap offset item indices when they exceed list limits.

inputs.name: Skip Singletons
inputs.info: Skip pairs with only a single defined element.

outputs.name: Item A
outputs.info: First item in each pair, picked from the first tree.

outputs.name: Item B
outputs.info: Second item in each pair, picked from the second tree.

nomen.name: Repeat Items
nomen.info: Repeat the items in a list a fixed number of times.

inputs.name: Repetitions
inputs.info: Number of times to repeat each item.

inputs.name: Repeat List
inputs.info: If true, the list as a whole is repeated, keeping the ordering of items mostly intact.

nomen.name: Repeat Items
nomen.info: Repeat the items in a list a fixed number of times.

inputs.name: Repetitions
inputs.info: Number of times to repeat each item.

nomen.name: Repeat List
nomen.info: Repeat a list until a given new length is reached.

nomen.name: Replace Indices
nomen.info: Replace items in a list by index.

inputs.name: Replacements
inputs.info: Replacing values. If not specified, the items will be replaced with nulls.

nomen.name: Replace Nulls
nomen.info: Replace all the nulls in a list.

nomen.name: Replace Paths
nomen.info: Replace some or all paths in a tree.

inputs.name: Search
inputs.info: Paths to replace. If omitted, all paths in the tree are replaced one by one.

nomen.name: Resize List
nomen.info: Resize a list by repeating its items until a given length is reached.

inputs.name: Repeat List
inputs.info: If true, the list as a whole is repeated, keeping the ordering of items mostly intact.

nomen.name: Shortest List
nomen.info: Shrink lists in a collection until they are all equally short.

nomen.name: Shrink
nomen.info: Shorten a list by removing items according to a specified culling method.

nomen.name: Snip List
nomen.info: Shorten a list by removing leading and/or trailing items.

inputs.name: Start
inputs.info: Number of items to remove from the beginning of the list.

inputs.name: End
inputs.info: Number of items to remove from the end of the list.

nomen.name: Split List
nomen.info: Split a list of items into two parts at a specified index.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of first item in the second output list.

outputs.name: First List
outputs.info: The portion of the original list that comes before the splitting index.

outputs.name: Second List
outputs.info: The portion of the original list starting at the splitting index.

nomen.name: Split Tree
nomen.info: Separate all items in a tree based on whether or not they pass path or index rules.

inputs.name: Splitting Rules
inputs.info: Splitting rules to apply to all items in the tree.

inputs.name: Insert Nulls
inputs.info: Insert nulls whenever an item is assigned to the other output.

outputs.name: Positive
outputs.info: All items in the tree which match at least one splitting pattern.

outputs.name: Negative
outputs.info: All items in the tree which match none of the splitting patterns.

nomen.name: Stack Items
nomen.info: Duplicate items in a list a given a number of times.

inputs.name: Stacking Pattern
inputs.info: Number of times to repeat each item.

nomen.name: Sub List
nomen.info: Extract from a list a section bounded by indices.

inputs.name: First Index
inputs.info: Index of the first value in the resulting sub list.

inputs.name: Second Index
inputs.info: Index of the last value in the resulting sub list.

outputs.name: Sub List
outputs.info: The portion of the original list between, and including, the bounding indices.

nomen.name: Tree Paths
nomen.info: Extract all the paths in a data tree.

outputs.name: Paths
outputs.info: All the paths in the tree.

outputs.name: Simplified Paths
outputs.info: All the paths, but in simplified form.

nomen.name: Weave
nomen.info: Weave a list by interspersing values from two or more input lists in a particular repeating pattern.

inputs.name: Pattern
inputs.info: Weaving pattern. Each integer in this pattern specifies from which input list the next item is picked.

nomen.name: All Tree Sites
nomen.info: Harvest all the sites of a data tree.

outputs.name: Sites
outputs.info: All the sites contained within the tree, with original topology.

nomen.info: Clean a data tree by nulls, invalid items and empty twigs.

inputs.name: Remove Nulls
inputs.info: If true, null values are removed from all twigs.

inputs.name: Remove Invalids
inputs.info: If true, invalid values are removed from all twigs.

inputs.name: Remove Empty
inputs.info: If true, twigs with no leaves are removed.

outputs.name: Twig Difference
outputs.info: Number of twigs that were removed.

outputs.name: Item Difference
outputs.info: Number of items and nulls that were removed.

nomen.name: Decode Index
nomen.info: Reorder items in a list based on their `Data.Index` meta data.

inputs.name: Items
inputs.info: List of items to be reordered.

nomen.name: Decode Sites
nomen.info: Harvest the `Data.Path` and `Data.Index` meta data from all items and recreate the implied tree.

nomen.name: Dissect Path
nomen.info: Extract the elements of a data tree path.

nomen.name: Encode Index
nomen.info: Assign the `Data.Index` meta data to all items in each list based on their current position.

nomen.name: Encode Sites
nomen.info: Assign `Data.Path` and `Data.Index` meta data to all items in a tree based on their current position.

nomen.name: Entwine
nomen.info: Combine inputs into a single output tree using a variety of mechanisms.

nomen.name: Explode Tree
nomen.info: Explode a tree and redirect each resulting list to a separate output.

outputs.info: This output is not matched to any twig in the tree.
This output is not matched to any twig in the tree.

nomen.name: Find Values
nomen.info: Find all indices where a specific value occurs in a list.

outputs.name: Indices
outputs.info: Indices of all items which match the search value.

nomen.name: Flatten Tree
nomen.info: Flatten a tree by moving all its items into a single list.

nomen.name: Flip Tree
nomen.info: Flip a tree by swapping one of the numbers in the path of each item, with that item's list index. When the tree represents a simple table, this has the effect of flipping rows and columns.

inputs.name: Path Number Index
inputs.info: Index of number within each path to be replaced with the item list index.

nomen.name: Graft By Key
nomen.info: Graft all lists in a tree by moving values with shared keys into their own lists.

nomen.name: Graft Tree
nomen.info: Graft a tree by moving each value into its own list.

nomen.name: Incremental Tree
nomen.info: Simplify the topology of a tree by restarting all path discontinuities at zero.

nomen.name: Path From Elements
nomen.info: Create a data tree path out of integer elements.

nomen.name: Path From Tree
nomen.info: Extract a specified path from a data tree.

nomen.name: Prune Tree
nomen.info: Prune a data tree by removing short or long branches.

inputs.name: Short Limit
inputs.info: Optional lower limit. Twigs with this many leaves or fewer will be removed.

inputs.name: Long Limit
inputs.info: Optional upper limit. Twigs with this many leaves or more will be removed.

inputs.name: Count Values
inputs.info: If true, only the non-null values are counted in each twig.

nomen.name: Renumber Tree
nomen.info: Modify the topology of a tree by incrementally renumbering all paths.

nomen.name: Replace Sites
nomen.info: Replace items in a tree.

inputs.name: Sites
inputs.info: Sites of tree items to be replaced.

nomen.name: Replace Values
nomen.info: Replace values in a list with other values.

nomen.name: Simplify Tree
nomen.info: Simplify the topology of a tree by removing the elements shared by all paths.

inputs.name: Alignment
inputs.info: Path alignment in case of differently sized paths.

nomen.name: Site From Index
nomen.info: Convert a linear index within a tree into a tree site.

nomen.name: Site From Offset
nomen.info: Create a tree site out of a list offset and an item index.

inputs.name: Offset
inputs.info: Index of the list within the tree.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of the item within the list.

outputs.name: Site
outputs.info: The specified site within the data tree.

nomen.name: Site From Path
nomen.info: Create a tree site out of a list path and an item index.

inputs.name: Path
inputs.info: Path for the list within the tree.

inputs.name: Index
inputs.info: Index of the item within the list.

outputs.name: Site
outputs.info: The specified site within the data tree.

nomen.name: Transfer Paths
nomen.info: Transfer paths from one tree to another.

nomen.name: Tree Length
nomen.info: Count the number of items contained in a tree, including all null values.

outputs.name: Length
outputs.info: Total number of values and nulls in the tree.

nomen.name: Tree Statistics
nomen.info: Calculate various statistics of the items contained in a data tree.

outputs.name: Length
outputs.info: Total number of items in the tree.

outputs.name: Values
outputs.info: Number of actual values in the tree.

outputs.name: Nulls
outputs.info: Number of nulls in the tree.

outputs.name: Metas
outputs.info: Number of values with associated meta data.

nomen.name: Tree Topology
nomen.info: Extract the topology of a data tree.

outputs.name: List Count
outputs.info: Total number of lists in the tree.

outputs.name: List Paths
outputs.info: The path associated with each list.
